assignmentTitle: Design Parameters of Spur Gears for Industrial Conveyor Systems
courseOutcome: CO1: Apply principle of Spur & Helical gear design for industrial application.

criteria.title: Kinematic Specification & Pinion Torque
criteria.description: Accurate determination of transmission ratio i = 3.00 and rated pinion torque T1 = 109,419.02 N·mm from motor power (11 kW) and input speed (960 rpm).

criteria.title: Spur Gear Visualisation & Tooth Terminology
criteria.description: Correct identification of conveyor spur gear drive components: driving pinion, driven gear, centre distance, pitch circle diameter, and line of action.

criteria.title: Spur Gear Pitch Geometry & Centre Distance
criteria.description: Accurate computation of pitch circle diameters (d1 = 80.00 mm, d2 = 240.00 mm) and standard centre distance (a = 160.00 mm) with module m = 4 mm.

criteria.title: Material Selection & Tooth Failure Evaluation
criteria.description: Correct identification of material characteristics (40Ni2Cr1Mo28 alloy steel pinion vs 55C8 plain carbon steel gear) and fundamental gear tooth failure modes.

criteria.title: Lewis Form Factors & Weaker Element Determination
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of Lewis form factors (Y1 = 0.3405, Y2 = 0.4362), permissible bending stresses (sigma_b1 = 266.67 MPa, sigma_b2 = 200.00 MPa), strength products (Pinion: 90.80 MPa vs Gear: 87.24 MPa), and identification of Gear as the weaker element.

criteria.title: Pitch-Line Velocity & Effective Dynamic Load
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of pitch line velocity (v = 4.02 m/s), Barth velocity factor (Cv = 0.7363), tangential load (Pt = 2735.48 N), and effective dynamic load (Peff = 6965.67 N) with Ka = 1.50 and Km = 1.25.

criteria.title: Lewis Beam Strength & Bending Safety Factor
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of Lewis beam strength based on weaker gear (Sb = 13,957.33 N) and resulting bending safety factor (FOSb = 2.00 >= 1.50: SAFE).

criteria.title: Buckingham Wear Strength & Wear Safety Factor
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of ratio factor (Q = 1.50), load-stress factor (K = 1.00 N/mm² for 250 BHN), Buckingham wear strength (Sw = 4800.00 N), and wear safety factor (FOSw = 0.689 < 1.50: UNSAFE).

criteria.title: Initial Failure Diagnosis & Root Cause Assessment
criteria.description: Deterministic diagnosis identifying wear/pitting contact fatigue as the governing failure mode requiring parametric redesign.

criteria.title: Parametric Redesign Computations (Options A, B, C)
criteria.description: Accurate recalculation for Option A (b=60mm: Sw=7200 N, FOSw=1.034 [Insufficient]), Option B (Gear 400 BHN: K=2.56 N/mm², Sw=12,288 N, FOSw=1.764 [Satisfies Target]), and Option C (m=5mm, b=60mm: d1=100mm, Peff=5745.89 N, Sw=9000 N, FOSw=1.566 [Satisfies Target]).

criteria.title: Engineering Redesign Trade-Off Defense & Selection
criteria.description: Faculty evaluation of student defense comparing gear surface hardening (Option B) vs module enlargement (Option C), considering casing envelope impact, centre distance change, heat-treatment feasibility of 55C8 plain carbon steel, and conveyor reliability.

criteria.title: Professional Reflection & Engineering Synthesis
criteria.description: Faculty evaluation of student reflection on spur gear design procedures, dynamic loading assumptions, pitting vs bending safety trade-offs, and professional engineering practice.
